confidence_notes: Citywide price data near July 2026 support both meal estimates, cappuccino, and draft beer. Cocktail and wine estimates use the premiums over domestic beer observed on a small sample of Jaipur bar menus. Lodging is modeled for July monsoon demand. [Jaipur restaurant prices](https://www.averagecostof.living/in/india/jaipur/restaurants/), [Clayborn bar menu](https://claybornjaipur.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/BAR-MENU-FINAL.pdf), [Kings Taproom menu](https://cdn1.simplotel.com/generic_uploads/production/46nWV8oN/jaipur_menu.pdf)
comparable_city_reasoning: Udaipur and Jodhpur are regional lodging comparables because their heritage tourism supports a similar mix of backpacker hostels, basic guesthouses, and mid-range hotels.
